description: §19.16.2 — what E-DEFER-LATER-SHADOW does NOT reject: a name declared BEFORE the defer (z), a name the deferred body declares itself (its own `q`, independent of the block's later `q`), and a later FUNCTION declaration (hoisted, so in scope at the defer). Runs: body writes "other;", then LIFO helper "h;", inner "q;", "z;": trace = "other;h;q;z;".
rationale: §19.16.2: only a read of a name re-bound by a LATER let/const/lin declaration is rejected; a deferred body's own declarations and hoisted function declarations are in scope as written.
